title: ERIS vs HubSpot
content_html:
HubSpot is the right choice if your core need is customer-facing software for marketing, sales and service teams, with pre-built AI agents and a free tier to start. ERIS is the right choice if you need one system across your entire business (from CRM to finance, HR, procurement and operations) with an AI assistant that works across all modules and runs on your own premises or in the Netherlands, with no outside AI provider touching your data.

What HubSpot is good at

HubSpot describes itself as an AI-powered customer platform with software for marketing, sales, customer service, content management, operations and commerce. According to its website, HubSpot offers an all-in-one Starter Customer Platform aimed at startups and small businesses, and an integrated Enterprise Customer Platform for larger organisations.

HubSpot includes Agent Hub, used for building and managing AI agents across the platform. It also offers Revenue Hub (CPQ, billing and payments software) and AEO (Beta), which provides answer engine optimisation tools to track and improve a brand's visibility in AI results.

The platform comes with free and premium plans, and HubSpot CRM is free to get started with no credit card required. HubSpot has integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot and Zapier on the Advanced plan, and the Enterprise plan connects to GitHub, Asana and more. According to its website, HubSpot CRM unifies customer data and helps teams personalise engagement across marketing, sales and service with connected tools and AI.

HubSpot is genuinely strong for companies whose primary need is managing customer relationships, marketing campaigns and sales pipelines. If your team lives in those three functions, HubSpot's focus and integrations are a natural fit.

What ERIS does differently

ERIS is built as one system for the whole business. It combines modules for meetings, tasks and projects, documents and e-signatures, CRM and sales, bookkeeping and tax, HR and payroll, compliance, procurement, warehouse and stock, production planning, IT helpdesk, and more. The ERIS Assistant answers questions across all of these modules on your company's own data, with every question and action logged.

ERIS runs on your company's own hardware with a local AI model, or hosted by Upward on its own servers in the Netherlands. No outside AI provider receives your data in either option. The AI reads and searches your documents. It is not trained on them.

ERIS is in development. The beta starts in November 2026 with design partners, and the official release is in January 2027. Eight core tools run in the beta: meetings, task manager, project management, document management, document signing, CRM, team chat and email. The remaining module groups (finance, HR, support, legal, compliance and more) come from January 2027 onwards, with new modules added weekly or monthly.

Pricing starts at €300 per user per month for companies with 1 to 9 staff (no platform licence). From 10 staff upwards, a platform licence applies alongside per-user fees. All standard modules are included at no extra cost.

Which one should you pick

Pick HubSpot if:

  • Your business is primarily sales, marketing and customer service focused.
  • You want to start free and add paid features as you grow.
  • You need AI agents built into a customer platform with integrations to tools you already use.
  • Your team is comfortable with cloud-based software and outside AI providers.

Pick ERIS if:

  • You need one system covering sales, finance, HR, operations, compliance and more.
  • Your data cannot or will not leave your company (GDPR, EU AI Act, NIS2 regulations).
  • You want an AI assistant that works across all your business modules, not just within one tool.
  • You prefer to run software on your own hardware or in a trusted hosting location.
  • You want one login, one data layer and one audit trail across your entire business.

If you need both:
Some companies use HubSpot for customer-facing functions and build or buy separate tools for finance, HR and operations. ERIS combines those functions, but it is still in beta. If you need a mature, proven customer platform today, HubSpot is the faster choice. If you can wait for the January 2027 release and your priority is consolidating your entire software stack, ERIS may fit better.

How ERIS differs on data and AI

HubSpot is a cloud platform. Its AI agents work within the HubSpot ecosystem. ERIS offers two deployment options: on your own servers, where data never leaves the building, or hosted by Upward on its own servers in the Netherlands. In both cases, the AI model runs locally. This matters if your industry or regulations require data to stay in-house. For more detail, see how local AI keeps enterprise data inside the firewall.

How ERIS differs on scope

HubSpot is built for customer teams. It does CRM, marketing, service and commerce well. ERIS is built for the whole company. It includes customer functions (CRM, sales) alongside finance, HR, operations and compliance. If you need to replace a stack of separate tools with one system, ERIS is designed for that. If you need best-in-class customer software, HubSpot is the more mature choice today.

FAQ

Can I use HubSpot and ERIS together?
Yes. Some companies use HubSpot for customer-facing work and ERIS for internal functions like finance, HR and operations. There is no technical barrier, though you would manage two separate systems and two audit trails.

Does ERIS have a free tier like HubSpot?
No. ERIS pricing starts at €300 per user per month for teams of 1 to 9 people. There is no free plan, but the beta is available on request.

Can I move my HubSpot data to ERIS?
ERIS is still in development. Migration tools from HubSpot are not confirmed. For specific migration questions, request access to the ERIS beta.

Does ERIS have AI agents like HubSpot?
ERIS has an AI assistant that works across all modules on your company data. It is not built as separate agents within each tool. For more on how this works, see how a local AI assistant uses company documents.

What if I only need customer software, not a full business system?
HubSpot is the better fit. It is mature, proven and focused on sales, marketing and service. ERIS is built for companies that need to replace many tools at once. If customer software is all you need, HubSpot remains the stronger choice.

When will ERIS be ready?
ERIS is in development. The beta starts in November 2026 with design partners. The official release is in January 2027. Request access to the ERIS beta.
